note: Pension and retiree health (OPEB). Held strictly separate from the capital backlog: different kind of obligation, different remedy, different politics. Current balances and accrual parameters extracted from the FY2025 ACFR (S13) on 2026-08-27.

current_valuation.measurement_date_note: GASB permits a one-year-lagged measurement date for pensions. Pension figures are measured at 2024-06-30 (valuation 2023-06-30); OPEB is measured at 2025-06-30. Both are as carried on the 2025-06-30 Statement of Net Position, which is how the City reports them.

pension.label: Net pension liability (CalPERS)
pension.observed_change_note: The net pension liability fell $26.7M over the measurement period, but that includes net investment income of $138.1M against roughly $107M expected at the 6.90% assumption. A strong market year is not a trend.

opeb.label: Net OPEB liability (retiree health)
opeb.discount_rate_basis: AA municipal bond rate, Bond Buyer 20 Index; crossover test failed so the bond rate applies
opeb.observed_change_note: The net OPEB liability fell sharply, but the fall is dominated by one-time items: assumption changes across all three plans and a $14.6M change in benefit terms in the Police plan, plus $6.6M in the Fire plan. Those do not repeat.

current_valuation.combined_note: Net pension liability plus net OPEB liability as carried on the 2025-06-30 Statement of Net Position.

actuarial_params.method: Structural accrual on the unfunded balance: interest at the plan discount rate, less the amortization payment (employer contributions above the employer share of normal cost). Excludes investment performance and one-time assumption or benefit-term changes, so it measures the funding policy rather than the market.

historical_series.label: Pension + retiree health (OPEB), combined unfunded liability
historical_series.comparability_warning: This series is inflation-adjusted and ends at FY2021. The current_valuation figures above are nominal and current. Do not splice them into one line without restating one basis onto the other.
historical_series.caveat: CalPERS contribution rates and discount-rate changes are partly outside the City's control. The Auditor says so explicitly. This series is context, not an accountability claim.

capital_backlog_series.label: Unfunded capital / deferred maintenance
capital_backlog_series.note: More than doubled FY2017 to FY2021. The FY2026 point is an estimate within a wide published band; see assumptions.json:backlog_basis.
